text:
alex: Heads up — LuminaPay is asking to increase their Dedicated commit for June–Aug by ~2.4x because of seasonal payroll batch tests. They sent a forecast: peak 420 GPU-hours/day, baseline 180 GPU-hours/day. Need guidance on headroom and pricing for buffer. @maria @sophia
maria: Can you paste the customer forecast doc? We need 95th pct traffic shape and p50 latency targets. Buffer policy we normally recommend 20% headroom for QPS variance; for bursty customers we suggest 35%.
john: FYI our cluster util in us-west-2 is already ~78% on GTX-pool during evenings. If we give 35% to them we'll need to reprovision or move workloads. Also watch networking slots — their KV cache replays ~2GB/s at peak.
sre-bot: build-monitor: us-west-2 gpu-pool avg_util=78%, spare_slots=12, preemptible_available=4
sophia: LuminaPay is willing to sign a 6mo reserved at a slightly higher commit if headroom is guaranteed. They prefer consistent latency <120ms p95.
alex: Proposal: commit = peak * 1.25 for guaranteed baseline (525 GPU-hrs/day) + 15% burst buffer (79 GPU-hrs/day) = ~604 GPU-hrs/day. Gives them 15% tail headroom, we avoid shifting other customers. Rough cost delta ~+$18k/mo. Thoughts?
maria: I like smaller committed buffer + auto-burst to spot when available. Suggest commit = 520, burst policy = up to 25% billed at overage rate, with guaranteed fallback model (smaller quantized variant) if capacity unavailable.
ops-anne: Need runbook changes if we accept: add canary routing and fallback chain, update billing metering to separate commit vs burst. Also preplan capacity migration window in July 1–3.
john: If we accept that commit, ops needs to reserve 7 nodes (A100-40) in us-west-2 on July 1. I'll open an infra change with exact sizing.
sophia: I'll push the pricing delta and the fallback SLA into the contract draft. @alex please confirm numbers so I can share with legal.
alex: Confirmed. I'll update the Calc and ping legal. Quick calc I used:
```
peak=420
commit=round(peak*1.25)=525
burst=round(commit*0.15)=79
total=commit+burst=604
```
alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
